issues.title: Bug: Document remains in "Pending" state when TSA is enabled behind an HTTP proxy
Add a “Stamp” Field Type to Allow Uploading and Placing Image Stamps on Documents
Date-only signed date fields show the previous day for viewers west of the document timezone
Typed signatures with Latin extended characters fall back to Noto Sans instead of Caveat
Common errors are not marked for translation
Security: Do not send the document as an attachment in the emails

latest_release.name: v2.22.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* chore: upgrade playwright and npm audit by @Mythie in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3506
* fix: prevent implicit form submission in editor field settings by @catalinpit in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3526
* chore: docs/update enterprise edition by @roshboi in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3472
* chore: update document visibility tooltip by @roshboi in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3529
* fix: clarify sender details setting by @catalinpit in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3499
* fix: disable signing when undo clears the signature pad by @catalinpit in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3518
* fix: improve text field signing ux by @dguyen in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3504
* fix(ui): ignore presses that start outside the signature pad by @catalinpit in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3522
* feat: add handwriting font option for initials fields by @catalinpit in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3474
* chore: skip the triage label for roadmap app issues by @ephraimduncan in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3573
* chore: remove redundant waitForTimeout calls by @catalinpit in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3536
* fix: open the 2fa code step when email is the only method by @ephraimduncan in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3528
* fix: format prefilled dates with the document date format by @ephraimduncan in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3527
* fix: use branding primary color for field loading spinner by @ephraimduncan in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3412
* feat: add content fields by @dguyen in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3395
* fix: send test events only to the selected webhook by @catalinpit in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3542
* chore: parallelise tests by @Mythie in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3574
* fix: correctly allow enterprise to bypass limits by @dguyen in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3590
* feat: add sort option for folders by @roshboi in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3473
* fix(i18n): add missing plural to analytics by @mKoonrad in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3424
* fix: open sign field dialogs on pointerclick so inputs autofocus by @catalinpit in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3583
* fix: allow hiding the download button in embed signing by @Mythie in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3589
* fix: normalise user and recipient emails to lowercase by @Mythie in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3591
* fix: respect document timezone in read-only date fields by @catalinpit in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3582
* fix: keep template field labels when prefill omits them by @Mythie in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3585
* chore: upgrade deps by @Mythie in https://github.com/documenso/documenso/pull/3602


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/documenso/documenso/compare/v2.21.1...v2.22.0
